shortDescription: Inventory configured APT repositories on a Debian/Ubuntu host

options.name: paths
options.description: List of glob patterns to scan for APT source files. Files ending in C(.sources) are parsed as deb822 stanzas; everything else is parsed as the classic single-line format. Patterns are expanded with C(glob.glob); non-existent patterns and non-regular files are silently ignored. The default covers the standard APT locations on Debian and Ubuntu.
